methods.label: Make ten
methods.explanation:
Since \(9\) needs \(1\) to reach \(10\), split \(7\) into \(1+6\). Then
\[
9+7=(9+1)+6=10+6=16.
\]
The result is \(16\).
methods.levelReason: Making ten uses Grade 1 addition and provides a lower-prerequisite route to the supplied sum.
